info.description: Config, schema, secret, durable caller-grant and KMS-authority APIs, plus encrypted credential custody. Owner mutations require a live Identity projection. Consumers call it through the generated clients in clients/go and clients/ts.
info.title: Putnami Config API

put.description:
Write plaintext configuration values for a specific dimension. The write rolls no revision: a workload reads the new value on its next deploy. The `roll` and `rollShared` query parameters and the `roll` response member are ignored and never set.

Required scopes: config.value.write.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

403.description: The caller is not allowed to access the requested scope

404.description: The requested config resource was not found

post.description:
Resolve and merge configuration values for an application environment. Pass secretsMode=redacted to merge secret shape without plaintext, or includeSecrets=true / secretsMode=reveal for plaintext (requires config.secret.read or an exact runtime service-account config claim).

Required scopes: config.value.read.

400.description: Invalid request body or validation error

403.description: The caller is not allowed to access the requested scope

404.description: The requested config resource was not found
